meta.name: aws-cli
meta.description: Safety-first AWS CLI v2 skill for full control of AWS from the terminal — EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, Route 53, EKS/ECS, logs, billing & 300+ services. Classifies every command by risk tier via a deterministic classifier script and gates destructive/breaking/cost-incurring ops behind AskUserQuestion confirmation. Account/region/profile preflight prevents wrong-account accidents. Use when running, planning, or debugging any `aws` command.
